systematic_sources.name: Awesome Test-Time Adaptation Resources
systematic_sources.verified_observation: Curated task-organized index containing hundreds of TTA papers and explicit 2025-2026 entries.

systematic_sources.name: In Search of Lost Online Test-Time Adaptation
systematic_sources.verified_observation: Peer-reviewed IJCV survey and benchmarking work for online TTA.

systematic_sources.name: Online Test-Time Adaptation benchmark repository
systematic_sources.verified_observation: Provides an extensible benchmark containing multiple TTA methods, datasets, models, and settings.

systematic_sources.name: Awesome CLIP TTA
systematic_sources.verified_observation: Tracks VLM test-time adaptation methods including 2026 methods.

systematic_sources.name: Active Learning Benchmark
systematic_sources.verified_observation: Reproducible classification active-learning benchmark with baseline and protocol support.

systematic_sources.name: Realistic Evaluation of Deep Active Learning
systematic_sources.verified_observation: Peer-reviewed evaluation emphasizing realistic protocol sensitivity for active-learning comparisons.

systematic_sources.name: TabArena / BeyondArena
systematic_sources.verified_observation: Living tabular benchmark with model/system separation and IID plus beyond-IID evaluation.

systematic_sources.name: TALENT
systematic_sources.verified_observation: Large tabular benchmark/toolbox spanning classical and deep methods across hundreds of datasets.

systematic_sources.name: OpenML AutoML Benchmark
systematic_sources.verified_observation: Extensible benchmark framework for comparing open-source AutoML systems.

systematic_sources.name: AgentGym
systematic_sources.verified_observation: Multi-environment agent framework with training, trajectories, evaluation and AgentEvol.

systematic_sources.name: Toolathlon
systematic_sources.verified_observation: ICLR 2026 long-horizon realistic tool-use benchmark with hundreds of tools.

systematic_sources.name: OpenAgent
systematic_sources.verified_observation: ICML 2026 controlled benchmark for open-world tool-use generalization under multiple forms of environment shift.

new_material_candidates.name: AgentEvol / AgentGym
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Provides a learned agent-evolution method across diverse interactive agent environments rather than only a fixed prompting scaffold.

new_material_candidates.name: SWE-RL
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Provides reinforcement-learning-based software-engineering reasoning, relevant only if the governed E1 task is software engineering.

new_material_candidates.name: GOLD
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Current CVPR 2026 continual-TTA method with classification and segmentation evaluation and explicit efficiency focus.

new_material_candidates.name: Test-Time Distillation / CoDiRe
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Uses an external frozen VLM supervisory signal during continual adaptation, so its information channel can materially affect comparator fairness.

new_material_candidates.name: BITTA
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Current ICLR 2026 VLM adaptation method evaluated with CLIP-style image classification.

new_material_candidates.name: D2O
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Training-free VLM test-time adaptation candidate surfaced through the current VLM-TTA systematic index.

screened_not_promoted.name: Toolathlon
screened_not_promoted.reason: Benchmark and evaluation environment, not itself a learned or fixed baseline implementation.

screened_not_promoted.name: OpenAgent
screened_not_promoted.reason: Benchmark for tool-use generalization under shift, not itself a comparison policy baseline.

screened_not_promoted.name: TabArena
screened_not_promoted.reason: Strength and benchmarking infrastructure; individual models/systems must be bound separately as baselines.

screened_not_promoted.name: TALENT
screened_not_promoted.reason: Benchmark/toolbox; individual methods must be separately selected and versioned.

screened_not_promoted.name: TTA-VLM benchmark resources
screened_not_promoted.reason: Benchmark evidence used to judge progress, not a standalone adaptation baseline.

screened_not_promoted.name: FGA
screened_not_promoted.reason: Material 2026 VLM-TTA paper surfaced by the systematic index, but this pass did not establish both the primary-paper binding and a reproducible official implementation sufficient for promotion.

screened_not_promoted.name: A2Memory
screened_not_promoted.reason: Material 2026 VLM-TTA method surfaced by the index, but reproducible implementation and exact matched-role evidence were not completed in this pass.

stopping_rule.reason: Systematic benchmark/index review produced multiple materially relevant candidate implementations absent from earlier Task-8 candidate artifacts.
